solutions.title: Extra rotated copy
solutions.strategy: Write each value into its rotated position in a temporary array, then copy the result back into the input array.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each input element is written once into the temporary array and once back into the input.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The temporary rotated copy stores n integers.

solutions.title: Reverse three sections
solutions.strategy: Reverse the whole array, reverse the rotated prefix, then reverse the remaining suffix to restore internal order.

timeComplexity.explanation: The three reversals together swap each element a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The rotation is performed in place with only two pointers.
